essence: Śiva is to be represented with one hand bearing discus and añjali and the other bearing conch and lotus.
The practitioner should fashion Śiva facing the other side as one turned toward grace.
Water and other items, sprouts, and the placement of jewels should be arranged in both locations.
Consecration, worship, and the preparation of the pavilion are required preliminary acts.
The twice-born should follow the earlier procedure using the marks of the nine, five, and one counts.
